name: @awebai/claude-skills
description: Content-only Claude Code plugin shipping the canonical aweb agent-coordination skills: aweb-coordination, aweb-messaging, aweb-team-membership, aweb-bootstrap, aweb-identity.

scripts.sync-skills: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../../skills/aweb-coordination ../../skills/aweb-messaging ../../skills/aweb-team-membership ../../skills/aweb-bootstrap ../../skills/aweb-identity skills/
scripts.prepack: npm run sync-skills && npm run sync-plugin-version
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run sync-skills && npm run sync-plugin-version
